resources.string: Choose whether to start capture after boot. Automatic capture is supported only on Android 10 (API 29) with all required access. Manual capture remains available on other versions. This page does not start capture or verify a physical cold boot.
Android API %1$d: automatic capture is not supported; use manual capture

For administrator-reviewed Android 10 (API 29) devices only. An ordinary app cannot grant itself persistent PROJECT_MEDIA access. An administrator must review and run these ADB commands from an authorized computer; copying does not execute them. These commands grant sensitive screen-capture and background access. Return to this page to refresh the actual status. Manual use does not require these grants.
ADB commands copied; nothing was executed
Clipboard unavailable. Read the commands above on an authorized computer.
Required access is present. Continue saves the boot preference only; capture configuration and real cold-boot behavior still need separate verification.
Automatic capture cannot be enabled yet. Grant all required access on Android 10 (API 29), turn off automatic boot capture, or choose manual use.
Continue saves automatic boot capture as off. You can start capture manually from the main screen.
Use manually — disable automatic boot capture
Back cancels setup without saving this choice or marking setup complete.
Could not save setup. Setup has not been completed. Check the existing configuration and storage, then try again.
The direct permission page is unavailable. Find this app in system settings, then return here.
System settings could not be opened. Ask the device administrator for help, or choose manual use.
